We’ve added two of our favorite features to expand its tonal capabilities in the Big Muff Pi 2 with Tone Wicker. Expanded top-end and a full-range fuzz make for even more unique muff tones. Built around the original Big Muff Pi 2 circuit, the pedal has the singing sustain and massive amounts of gain while occupying its very own voice, which sets it apart from the classic Big Muff Pi. A familiar control set of VOL/TONE/SUSTAIN lets you tweak your sound like the original while the TONE and WICKER switches bring even more tones to the table. The TONE switch bypasses the tone knob from the circuit completely creating a full spectrum distortion. The 3-position WICKER switch opens high-frequency filters in the circuit adding two additional levels of bright and clear top-end. This is especially useful with lower TONE knob settings. The Big Muff Pi 2 with Tone Wicker features a footswitch with Latching/Momentary Action. Click the footswitch for normal latching functionality or press and hold the footswitch of a momentary burst of fuzz mayhem! Unique Big Muff Pi circuit design employing 2 Dual Op-Amps VOL, TONE, and SUSTAIN controls TONE bypass switch removes TONE knob from circuit for an unfiltered full range fuzz WICKER switch adds two levels of extended high-end clarity at any TONE setting Latching/Momentary action on a soft footswitch 9V Battery included, adapter optional SPECIFICATIONS Circuit Analog Audio Mono Power Supply 9V battery included (optional 9.6VDC-200mA power adapter not included) Dimensions (in) 4.75 x 4 x 2.25 Current Draw 20mA Year Released 2026 UPC 683274012735 Owner's Manual Download 9VDC Power Jack An optional 9VDC, center-negative power supply may be connected to the power jack to provide power without a battery. The Big Muff Pi 2 with Tone Wicker requires 20mA at 9VDC on a center-negative plug. Do not exceed 12VDC at the power jack. VOLUME Knob Sets the output level of your Big Muff 2 with Tone Wicker. TONE Knob Provides a range of sounds from high treble to deep bass. As you turn the knob clockwise the treble increases and bass decreases. SUSTAIN Knob Adjusts the amount of sustain and distortion. sources.excerpt: Big Muff Pi 2 with Tone Wicker by Electro-Harmonix | RockBoard | PedalPedia Skip to main content LOG IN EXPLORE Electro-Harmonix Big Muff Pi 2 with Tone Wicker LOG IN TO SUGGEST IMPROVEMENTS FUZZ Description This guitar effects pedal utilizes a dual op-amp gain circuit based on the rare 1970s V4 design to deliver a mids-forward bark and massive sustain. It features a unique three-position Wicker switch that progressively opens high-frequency filters for added clarity and bite. A dedicated Tone switch allows the user to bypass the tone control entirely for a raw, full-spectrum fuzz sound. The pedal includes a soft footswitch that supports both standard latching and momentary operation for quick bursts of distortion. It maintains the classic layout of Volume, Tone, and Sustain knobs while offering expanded tonal flexibility over the original NYC model. This unit provides a versatile range of textures from thick, saturated fuzz to bright, articulate distortion in a compact chassis.
